sections.heading: Planning a complex migration?
sections.body: Core-platform migrations affect custom applications, connected services and business-critical data. When teams work in separate streams, dependencies and regression risks can become visible only near cutover. Programme assurance connects those streams before release decisions are made.

sections.heading: Know what is ready for cutover
sections.body: The intended outcome is an evidenced view of migration readiness across applications, integrations and security. Combine automated regression, integration rebuilds and security validation around agreed acceptance gates. Track reconciliation exceptions, critical-journey test results and unresolved dependencies against your programme baseline.

items.title: Can you assure a programme with multiple suppliers?
items.description: An assurance workstream can sit across delivery teams. Agree access to plans and evidence, decision rights, escalation routes and the boundaries between independent review and work we deliver.

items.title: What makes a migration ready?
items.description: Readiness is defined for your business: critical journeys, data reconciliation, integrations, security and operational support. We help turn these into acceptance criteria and track evidence against them.

items.title: How is Linkworks used alongside ERP or CRM?
items.description: Linkworks supports composable custom applications and extensions where standard ERP or CRM does not fit. Platform selection, application ownership and integration boundaries are agreed before a build.

items.title: What should we bring to an initial discussion?
items.description: Bring the programme scope, target platform, integration inventory and current test or cutover plan. We can identify missing evidence and propose a scoped readiness assessment.
